label: Total installed wind capacity of the Republic of Ireland
scope: Republic of Ireland, onshore and offshore (offshore 25.2 MW), net installed
source_name: IEA Wind TCP Annual Report 2022, Ireland chapter by the national team
source_says: Total (net) installed wind power capacity 4.536 GW; Total offshore capacity .0252 GW
notes: The report's table prints decommissioned capacity as 0.631 GW while its text says 63 MW; the capacity totals are not affected. The figure comes from SEAI, which draws on EirGrid and ESB data, so this checks our reading of the lists, not the lists themselves
